A '''P2-series astromech droid''' was owned by [[Devon Fuller]] around [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was later acquired by [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]], who took the [[P2-series astromech droid|unit]] when Fuller offered it to him in place of a sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] he owed him. During a battle between Garnet's [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces, the droid misunderstood a simple command, and dropped Garnet's [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. Garnet later [[Spacing/Legends|spaced]] the droid and vowed to have words with Fuller.
